candidate.claim: Under fixed noisy-evaluation oracle budgets, preserving optimization depth and integrating ranking uncertainty at selection time can outperform spending many evaluations on evaluation-stage denoising; a rank-disagreement probe can selectively route between uncertainty-aware and vanilla search.

primary_source.title: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
primary_source.source_status: primary author-hosted ICML publication page with full paper text/tables

main_matched_oracle_budget_results.protocol: COCO bbob-noisy: 30 functions x 15 instances per dimension at B=200d for d in {10,20,40}; six external tasks with 50 independent seeds each. Probe-and-Switch uses tau=0.12. Each COCO instance is run once per method.

adaptive_routing_value.protocol: B=100d; all 30 COCO functions split by probe-defined high-misranking subset versus complement; d in {10,20,40}, 15 instances/function, 675 matched problems per column.
adaptive_routing_value.interpretation: Always-on uncertainty smoothing is beneficial in the selected high-misranking regime but harmful on the stable complement; adaptive routing recovers most high-misranking gain while avoiding much of the low-misranking penalty.

rank_instability_vs_variance_probe.radial_noise_protocol: sigma_eff(x)=0.5||x-x0||, d in {80,160,320}, B=200d, 54 problems, each once per method.
rank_instability_vs_variance_probe.routing_head_to_head: rank-disagreement switching wins on 39/54 vs variance switching; sign-test p=0.0007
rank_instability_vs_variance_probe.scope: This establishes that local pointwise variance can fail as a trigger under the constructed state-dependent noise regime; it is not a universal theorem that variance diagnostics are useless.

probe_budget_and_threshold.threshold_plateau: misranking-probe routing accuracy varies by about 2 percentage points over tau in [0.08,0.18]; MR exceeds the variance proxy by roughly 5-6 points across thresholds
probe_budget_and_threshold.scope: tau=0.12 and the lambda plateau are empirical settings for this study, not universal constants.

depth_loss_and_hidden_resampling_checks.UH_maxevals_sweep: At d=40, B in {200d,500d}, maxevals in {1,10,30}; increasing maxevals monotonically reduces UH-CMA-ES win rate versus CMA-ES and Probe-and-Switch under the fixed oracle budget.
depth_loss_and_hidden_resampling_checks.Kmax0_ablation: On 225 high-misranking COCO problems at d=40, B=100d, RB-PEM retains a 66% win rate versus CMA-ES when Kmax=0, where per-generation evaluation cost is essentially vanilla CMA-ES. This disfavors hidden boundary resampling as the main source of gain.
depth_loss_and_hidden_resampling_checks.representative_failure_trace: In one diagnostic example, a bad RB-PEM run exhausted budget by generation 129 while a good run reached generation 211, a reported 39% depth loss; this is illustrative rather than a population-average causal estimate.

real_data_external_task.digits0_MLP: n=256, d=265, total oracle budget B=40d=10,600, 50 random seeds per method/batch-size pair
real_data_external_task.scope: Small nonconvex real-data optimization with minibatch-induced numerical objective noise; not an LLM-judge experiment.

assumption_and_cost_scope.wall_clock: At d=40, B=100d, median wall-clock overhead is reported around 1.70x/1.64x for RB-PEM variants and 1.66x/1.62x for Probe-and-Switch variants relative to CMA-ES. Thus equal oracle-call budget is not equal wall-clock or total computation.
assumption_and_cost_scope.Cauchy: Raw Cauchy noise violates the finite-variance assumption. The implementation clips standardized residuals and bootstraps from a winsorized working distribution; Cauchy results are empirical robustness stress tests, not theorem-valid raw-Cauchy guarantees.

scope_clarifications: The fixed-budget claim is primarily a fixed number of black-box oracle evaluations. It should not be paraphrased as equal wall-clock, equal FLOPs, equal LLM tokens, or equal dollar cost; the source reports ~1.6-1.7x median wall-clock overhead for selection-stage variants in one setting.

The noise model is stochastic black-box objective noise. Semantic LLM-judge hallucination, systematic bias, adversarial feedback, and correlated judge errors are different regimes; transfer to LLM population/QD selection is a mechanism hypothesis requiring direct testing.

The evidence supports conditional/adaptive uncertainty handling, not always-on smoothing: always-on RB-PEM loses badly on the stable complement while Probe-and-Switch approaches parity by reverting to vanilla CMA-ES.
Extreme-noise near-parity on digits0 is evidence for a saturation regime in that task, not a universal threshold for when verification becomes useless.
The COCO aggregate protocol uses one run per method per instance, aggregated across many functions/instances/dimensions; do not report per-instance run-to-run variance where none was measured.

The probe statistic is directly tested as decision-relevant rank instability. Its superiority to a point-variance proxy is established under a constructed radial-noise counterexample and broader empirical calibration, but does not prove it is the optimal trigger for every noisy search system.
confidence: high for ICML primary method, tables and appendix ablations; medium only for transfer to semantic LLM/multi-agent search
unresolved: Direct LLM/QD experiment at matched total token/dollar/wall-clock budget comparing search depth, uniform re-judging, uncertainty-aware selection and adaptive decision-instability routing.
Injected semantic judge-noise/correlated-bias sweep measuring archive corruption, selection regret or final search quality.
Principled saturation criterion for switching from hard selection to reversible/evidence-collection mode when comparisons become effectively uninformative.
downstream_instruction: Retain C26 as strong source-domain fixed-oracle-budget evidence that repeated denoising can sacrifice adaptive search depth and that decision-relevant rank instability is a useful routing signal. Do not translate the numeric win rates or tau/probe settings into universal LLM-search constants, and explicitly distinguish oracle-call budget from wall-clock/token/dollar cost.
